The '''Science Speed''' team (Japanese: '''サイエンススピード''' ''Science Speed'') are [[character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]''.

They are a group of {{tc|Scientist}}s whom entered the [[Charjabug race]] with a {{p|Charjabug}}. They raced against {{Ash}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and {{an|Kiawe}} who had entered with [[Sophocles's Charjabug]] and {{TRT}}, who disguised {{MTR}} as a Charjabug. During the race, they managed to keep up with the Red Comet team, the Sophocles Lab team, and the [[Team Electric Princess|Electric Princess team]]. During the second section of the race, however, their Charjabug got stuck in a sand pit and was not able to move any further. With this, the Science Speed team was eliminated from the race.
